FAQs

Something not here? Email thedearlyco@gmail.com and we’ll get back to you within 24 hours.

Will the chain break or feel cheap?

No, it has a lobster claw clasp and an adjustable chain. If you don’t think it’s up to standard, feel free to send it back within 90 days for a full refund.

Will it tarnish or turn her skin green?

Nope. She can wear it every day and even sleep in it. We recommend taking it off in the shower, in pools, and in the ocean though, because water, chlorine and salt dull any jewelry over time.

Will there be a price or invoice inside?

No. Nothing in the package shows what you paid, your receipt goes to your email only.

When will it arrive?

7 to 14 days, and shipping’s free. You’ll get a tracking link when it ships. Need it by a certain date? Give it three weeks to be safe.

How big is the pendant?

A little under an inch wide: 0.91 in by 0.51 in (2.3 cm by 1.3 cm). Small enough for every day, big enough that you actually see it.

How long is the chain?

17.7 in (45 cm), plus a 2 in (5 cm) extender. On most people it sits right at the collarbone. If it’s not right on her, send it back. You’ve got 90 days.

Do you ship outside the US?

Yes, anywhere, and it’s still free. Outside North America and Europe it can take a bit longer.

What if it arrives damaged?

Email us a photo and we’ll send a new one, free. Keep the broken one, we don’t need it back.

What is your return policy?

90 days, full refund. Just email thedearlyco@gmail.com and we’ll sort it out.
